Translation for Voice Pack 1 - Morning

*Door opens*

aa, you've woken up?
Good Morning!
Hm? This is breakfast!
Though, it is almost noon...

Come over here and taste my cooking.
So, how is it?
Tasty?
Right right, of course it is tasty.
I included the special ingredient 'Love' afterall!

*Blaring alarm sound*

Are you still asleep?
Hurry up and wake up
You are already late
Idiot
